submission.justification: Absorber-F2 with 4mm plate thickness achieves the best energy resolution of 3.141% at 100 GeV among all tested configurations. This represents the optimal balance for F2 material, outperforming both thinner (3mm: 3.481%) and thicker (5mm: 3.246%) plates. F2 significantly outperforms F1 (best: 5.195% at 5mm) and F3 (best: 3.886% at 5mm). The thickness of 4mm falls within the required 2-10mm range. CRITICAL CAVEAT: The residual dose rate constraint (≤20 μSv/h at 1m after one week cooldown) could not be verified due to missing dose rate data. This hard safety requirement must be validated through additional radiation physics analysis or experimental measurements before final implementation.
